title: Planner
loadErrorBody: Your sessions are safe. Check your connection and try again.
emptyBody: Turn a series or a list into a schedule: pick your evenings and Avleron works out the finish date.
scheduleErrorBody: Sessions stay safe. Reconnect and try again.

side.noActive: No active plans. Finished ones stay on their own page.

move.title: Reschedule {{units}}
move.shift: Shift all later sessions by the same amount ({{sessions}})

plan.missingBody: It may have been deleted, or the link is wrong. Private plans open only for their owner and members.
plan.viewerBanner: You can view this plan. Ask {{owner}} for editor access to mark sessions.
plan.linkBannerUser: You’re viewing a shared plan. Only its members can mark sessions.
plan.linkBannerGuest: You’re viewing a shared plan. Sign in if it was shared with you.
plan.finishedSeries: Every session is done. New episodes? Plan the next season.
plan.deleteBody: All {{sessions}} will be removed. Library progress stays.
plan.deleteBodyShared: All {{sessions}} will be removed for you and {{members}}. Library progress stays.
plan.leaveBody: You’ll lose access to this plan. Your own library progress stays. To come back, ask {{owner}} to invite you again.

errors.permission: You don’t have permission to change this plan.
errors.listMissing: This list doesn’t exist or isn’t shared with you.
errors.nothingToSchedule: There’s nothing to schedule with these settings.

new.heading: New watch plan
new.emptyList: This list has no movies yet. Add some to the list, or pick a series instead.
new.emptySeries: This series has no aired episodes yet, so there’s nothing to plan.

source.hint: Search for a series to plan, for example “Breaking Bad”.
source.noLists: You don’t have any lists yet. Make one with the movies for your marathon.

start.continueDesc: Right after your last watched episode ({{code}}) · {{episodes}}
start.caughtUp: You’ve watched every aired episode. Plan a rewatch from the start or any episode.
start.leftOut_one: {{count}} series in this list is left out: a marathon plans movies. Plan a series on its own.
start.leftOut_other: {{count}} series in this list are left out: a marathon plans movies. Plan a series on its own.

preview.name: Plan name
preview.banner: You can reschedule or skip any session later. Moving one can shift all later ones.
preview.pickFirst: Pick a series or a list
preview.numbers: The numbers appear as soon as there is something to plan.

marathon.title: Plan a movie marathon
marathon.body: {{movies}}, one per evening on the days you pick. Avleron works out the finish date.
